summary: [spec-fidelity] The new changed_since_migrate guard misses files deleted after migration. diff puts a snapshot file absent from the current tree into restore (line 1126), but the guard at line 1097 only flags an entry when now.files.get(path).is_some_and(...). For a non-derived file present both in the snapshot and sealed post-migrate state, subsequently deleted, this is false; revert therefore restores the deleted file instead of refusing the later change. This contradicts the promise to refuse when a file changed since migration. Fix: compare the optional current hash against the optional sealed hash, so Some-to-None is a change while files removed by migration itself remain allowed; add a regression deleting a sealed non-journal file after migration. Blast radius: whole-snapshot revert protection, not only rewritten briefs. Established by code-path inspection; no reproduction command was run.
